items.title: Sharing a Freshly Torn Bread Loaf
items.alt: Two pairs of hands pull a round crusty loaf apart above a board with olive oil, tomatoes and olives.
items.description: The open bread reveals an airy crumb, with the small dipping bowl centered between tomato wedges on the handled board.

items.title: Let’s Feast Turkey Lettering
items.alt: Cream and rust lettering reads “LET’S FEAST” above roast turkey, corn and cranberries between a fork and spoon.
items.description: Shaded rounded letters and autumn leaves form a compact food-themed graphic around the complete serving platter.

items.title: Feast with Friends Turkey Banner
items.alt: A cream ribbon reading “FEAST WITH FRIENDS” arches above roast turkey, green beans and stuffing.
items.description: Small leafy flourishes finish the curved banner while the two side dishes extend the low, welcoming food arrangement.

items.title: Share the Table Food Lettering
items.alt: Green “SHARE THE TABLE” lettering sits above a fruit bowl and bread basket framed by open hands.
items.description: Red apples, purple and green grapes, a yellow-orange fruit and crusty rolls add warm color beneath the three lines of text.

items.title: Turkey Drumstick Feast over a Campfire
items.alt: Two roasted turkey drumsticks cook with corn and potatoes in a black skillet over a small campfire stand.
items.description: A blue enamel mug and cloth-wrapped bread loaf complete the compact outdoor meal beside the full skillet handle.

items.title: Grilled Vegetable Skewer Feast
items.alt: Grilled skewers with mushrooms, zucchini and peppers share a pale tray with flatbread, green dip and tomato salad.
items.description: Long wooden sticks point toward the front of the tray, creating a diagonal arrangement beside the neatly separated accompaniments.
